spans.s: भदंत m. 1. A term of respect applied to a Buddhist, भदंत निरूप्यतां तावदस्मत्प्रस्थानदिवसः Mud.iv.; 2. a Buddhist mendicant.
भदाक m. Fortune, prosperity.

भद्र (I) a. (f. द्रा) 1. Auspicious, happy, prosperous; 2. able, kind, pious; 3. desirable, laudable; 4. lovely, beautiful; 5. beloved, dear; 6. plausible, hypocritical-; 7. head, chief, principal, पप्रच्छ भद्रं विजितारिभद्रः R.xiv.31.
भद्र (II) n. 1. Prosperity, happiness, welfare, भद्रं भद्रं वितर भगवन् भूयसे मंगलाय M.M.i.; (in this sense the word is often used in the pl., e.g. नरो भद्राणि पश्यतु); 2. gold; 3. iron, steel.

भद्र (III) m. 1. A bull; 2. a hypocrite, M.ix.258; 3. a wagtail; 4. a term applied to a particular species of elephants; 5. an epithet of Śiva; 6. an epithet of mount Meru; 7. a title of address (sir).(भद्राकृ ‘to shave’; भद्राकरण n. ‘shaving.’)

भद्र (I) a. (f. द्रा) 1. Auspicious, happy, prosperous; 2. able, kind, pious; 3. desirable, laudable; 4. lovely, beautiful; 5. beloved, dear; 6. plausible, hypocritical-; 7. head, chief, principal, पप्रच्छ भद्रं विजितारिभद्रः R.xiv.31.
भद्रा f. 1. A cow; 2. name of the second, seventh and twelfth days of a lunar fortnight; 3. the celestial Ganges; 4. a term of respect used in addressing ladies.
भाद्र m. Name of a lunar month.
भद्र-अंग m. an epithet of Balarāma.
भद्र-आत्मज m. a sword.
भद्र-आसन n. 1. a chair of state, a throne; 2. a particular posture of sitting in meditation.
भद्र-ईश m. an epithet of Śiva.
भद्र-एला f. large cardamoms.
भद्र-कपिल m. an epithet of Śiva.
भद्रंकर a. causing prosperity.
भद्र-कुंभ m. a golden jar filled with water from a holy place, especially from the Ganges.
भद्र-गणित n. the construction of magical diagrams.
भद्र-घट, -घटक m. a vessel from which a lottery is drawn.
भद्र-घट, -घटक m. a vessel from which a lottery is drawn.
भद्र-दारु m.n. a sort of pine.
भद्र-नामन् m. a wagtail.
भद्र-पीठ n. 1. a splendid seat, a throne; 2. a kind of winged insect.
भद्र-बलन m. an epithet of Balarāma.
भद्र-मृग m. an epithet of a particular kind of elephant.
भद्र-रेणु m. a name of Indra’s elephant.
भद्र-वत् n. the devadāru tree.
भद्र-वर्मन् m. a kind of jasmine.
भद्र-शाख m. an epithet of Kārtikeya.
भद्र-श्रय, -श्रिय n. the sandal-wood.
भद्रा-श्रय n. sandal-wood.
भद्र-श्रय, -श्रिय n. the sandal-wood.
भद्र-श्री f. the sandal tree.
भद्र-सोमा f. an epithet of the Ganges.
भद्रक (I) a. (f. द्रिका) 1. Good; 2. handsome, beautiful.
भद्रक (II) m. The devadāru tree.
भद्रक (I) a. (f. द्रिका) 1. Good; 2. handsome, beautiful.
भद्रिका f. 1. An amulet; 2. name of the second, seventh and twelfth days of a lunar fortnight.
भाद्र m. Name of a lunar month.
भाद्रपदा f. pl. A common appellation of the twenty-fifth and twenty-sixth lunar asterisms.
भाद्रपदी f. The day of full moon in the month of Bhādrapada.
भाद्रपदी f. The day of full moon in the month of Bhādrapada.
भाद्रमातुर m. The son of a virtuous mother.
